mentions.name: Olympic wrestling education tool
mentions.description: This Olympic wrestling education tool indexes multiple captured video streams with awarded action points and adds athlete/referee position overlays. A stretch goal is controlling a PTZ camera for predictive capture of high-intensity actions.
